title: Hilton Named No. 1 Best Workplace for Women in the U.S. for Eighth Consecutive Year, Celebrates 11 Years on Prestigious List
summary: Hilton was named the No. 1 Best Workplace for Women in the U.S. for the eighth consecutive year, marking its 11th straight year on the list.

Team members rank Hilton the top U.S. workplace for women for the eighth consecutive year, adding to a year of recognition across 20 countries and regions


- **Hilton was named the No. 1 Best Workplace for Women in the U.S. for the eighth consecutive year, marking its 11th straight year on the list.**
- **Hilton was also recognized as a Best Workplace for Women in 20 countries over the past year, including seven No. 1 rankings.**
- **Hilton supports women's career growth through human and AI-powered BetterUp coaching, professional development and global community-building.**
- **Benefits support women through different career and life stages: Wellthy provides caregiving navigation; Progyny offers fertility and family-building support; and Bloom delivers virtual pelvic health therapy.**


**McLEAN, Va. –**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) (NYSE: HLT) has been named the **No. 1 Best Workplace for Women in the U.S.** by *Fortune* and Great Place to Work for the **eighth consecutive year** , marking its 11th straight year on the list. The honor follows recognition as a[Best Workplace for Women](https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best-workplaces/women/2026) in 20 other countries and regions over the past year, including No. 1 rankings in Argentina, Colombia, France, Germany, Japan, Uruguay and the Middle East.


This recognition reflects Hilton’s longstanding commitment to creating an award-winning culture where women can grow, lead and thrive throughout every stage of their careers and lives. Across Hilton’s global business, women shape its culture, lead hotels and businesses, deliver industry-leading hospitality and drive innovation across the company.


“Throughout my career, I have been continually inspired by the women of Hilton — their ambitions, their experiences and the impact they make when they find their voice and have the confidence to use it,” said Laura Fuentes, chief human resources officer and head, Hilton Supply Management. “This recognition reflects the culture our team members create every day: one where women are empowered to speak up, lead boldly and help make Hilton and our communities stronger.”


That culture is reinforced by programs that support women’s professional development, wellbeing and changing needs throughout their careers and lives, including:


- **Wellthy:** Helps team members manage the complex logistics of caring for children, aging parents and other loved ones. By easing the administrative burden of caregiving, Wellthy helps working women protect their time, wellbeing and ability to thrive at work; since launching, Wellthy has saved Hilton team members approximately 44,000 hours of caregiving-related logistical work.
- **Progyny:** Provides personalized fertility and family-building support, including expert guidance and access to treatment options for IVF, surrogacy and infertility care. The benefit helps working women pursue their family-building goals and unique path to parenthood with greater clarity, flexibility and confidence while continuing their careers.
- **Bloom** **:** Offers private, clinical-grade virtual pelvic physical therapy from home for needs spanning pregnancy, postpartum, menopause and other life stages. Bloom’s convenient virtual model helps working women access specialized care without adding unnecessary travel or appointments to demanding schedules.
- **BetterUp Coaching:** Provides personalized human and AI-powered coaching to help team members strengthen leadership skills, navigate career transitions and pursue professional goals. This flexible, confidential support helps working women build confidence, resilience and the skills to grow and lead throughout their careers.


Together, these programs and communities help team members build meaningful careers while delivering Hilton’s signature hospitality.


For more information on careers at Hilton, visit[jobs.hilton.com](https://jobs.hilton.com/) .

## About Hilton


Hilton (NYSE: HLT) is a leading global hospitality company with a portfolio of 28 world-class brands comprising more than 9,600 properties and over 1.4 million rooms, in 144 countries and territories. Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the more than 270


million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) , guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone.
